classification.reason: This matches known issue KI-120 (mobile timezone bug pre-4.2, with a documented workaround) and involves no refund, fraud accusation, or discretionary request.

draft.reply:
Hi,

Thanks for flagging this. What you're seeing is a known issue: time tracking entries submitted from the mobile app before app version 4.2 can show the wrong timezone.

To fix the affected entries, please re-submit them from the web app — this will correct the timezone. We'd also recommend updating to the latest mobile app version to prevent this from happening with future entries.

Sorry for the inconvenience, and let us know if you run into any trouble with the workaround.

Best,
Loopwise Support
